description.value: The study delineated regions of reduced glucose metabolism in frontotemporal dementia and investigated hemispheric asymmetry using 18F-FDG PET.

spans.text: The aim of the current study was 2-fold: first, to delineate the brain regions with reduction of glucose metabolism in FTD using SPM analysis of 18F-FDG PET images; and second, to investigate the hemispheric asymmetry of glucose metabolism in FTD, which has not been systematically studied.

design.value: A voxel-wise SPM comparison of 18F-FDG PET images from 29 patients with FTD and 11 age- and sex-matched healthy individuals, together with ROI- and SPM-based measures of hemispheric asymmetry.

spans.text: We compared the regional metabolic patterns on 18F-FDG PET images obtained from 29 patients with FTD and 11 healthy subjects using a voxel-wise analysis (statistical parametric mapping [SPM]).
MMSE = Mini-Mental State Examination.
